notes.title: Stones of Solace - Free on Steam - August 20th
notes.content:
Just a little announcement that upcoming label project Stones of Solace now has: 
 a release date (in only 2 weeks!)
 a Steam page
 and a price (FREE!)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122880/Stones_of_Solace/?curator_clanid=33711478
More info on our site --> http://www.icewatergames.com/solace

(If you like the game and want to support the artists, the itch.io page (linked on our site) will have a pay-what-you-want option, too!)

notes.title: Spring Cleaning
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33562611/2133eb98332d9f38646c6f54aa5c911b8259b647.gif

Just some light cleaning before we stop patching this over the summer. More updates come fall or winter, I suspect!
 Default + demo environment changed to the forest to be more seasonal
 Minor bug fixing
 Updated IWG splash screen + removed the Badru splash (maybe I'll put it back in over the loading smoke at a later date)
 UI polish - cleaner, more intentional layouts, animation, sound
H.A.G.S.
- Badru

notes.title: Vignettes!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/944340/Vignettes/
Hi lovers of peaceful things! 

Did you know that Pol Clarissou (of the spooky pink ceramics) is also a key part of the team that put together Vignettes, the award winning object-observer / casual exploration game? 

Did you know that Vignettes is coming to Steam tomorrow?? 

- Badru

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/jUniRZD.gif

 New environment - harvest field! 
 Fixed a major rendering bug that alternately caused the fire to render all white or not at all on some devices
 Added Mac and Linux support
 Tweaked the presets a bit
 Holding right click with the log tool now lets you rotate the log
 Improved the feeling of scaling logs and paper
 Adjusted the audio levels
 Happy Halloween!
